title: Anenji ANJ-11KW-48V-WIFI-P 0x8401 beta.4 support archive
summary: A beta.4 support archive captured the exact Modbus fingerprint layout 4 and model code 0x8401 for an Anenji ANJ-11KW-48V-WIFI-P. The same collector and inverter identity had previously been classified by the cloud as devcode 6544 and had operated through the Anenji Protocol 4 map on v0.2.0. The new fingerprint therefore receives exact commercial identity and Protocol 4 telemetry, while its local write controls remain explicitly untested.
